description: The rules a host, platform or rental car company has to follow when charging a traveller for damage, for Australia or the US. Returns plain facts, the evidence to ask for, where to escalate and official sources. Use when someone asks whether a damage bill or charge is allowed or fair.

country.description: AU for Australia, US for the United States. Defaults to the site that was called

platform.description: Who sent the bill, e.g. Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, Stayz, Hipcamp, Hertz, Sixt, Avis, Budget, Enterprise, Europcar, Turo, Zipcar, Outdoorsy, RVshare, Camplify, JUCY, Britz, Maui, a direct host

name: get_damage_rules
title: Damage charge rules
